description: Pneo: the Tn5 neo (nptII, kanR) promoter region, 50 bp (U00004 1413-1462).

references.title: The functional differences in the inverted repeats of Tn5 are caused by a single base pair nonhomology.

label: Pneo
note: Promoter of the Tn5 neo (nptII) kanamycin-resistance gene: the 50 bp that the Tn5 record U00004 annotates as the aminoglycoside phosphotransferase promoter region (1413-1462, experimental evidence). Rothstein and Reznikoff (1981) found that the one base differing between IS50L and IS50R (U00004 1442, base 30 here) makes a better promoter. The -35, -10 and start are not placed: provisional boundaries. The 120 bp this part carried before were 12 bp of Tn5 upstream of this window (U00004 1401-1412), 57 bp of Tn5 downstream of it (1463-1519), and 51 bp of linker and ribosome binding site that Tn5 does not carry at all.

provenance.sequence_source: U00004 (transposon Tn5), positions 1413-1462, 100% over 50 bp; the record's annotated promoter region
